algorithm: {This algorithm computes priority for each bin as the negative of the remaining capacity after inserting the given item, with negative infinity assigned to any bin that cannot fit the item, such that higher priority values correspond to bins where the item will leave the least unused space.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return priorities
